title: Logo Intro
slide_intent: Connect the logo to what the service offers so its construction has a purpose the reader can judge.
strategic_value: Explaining the symbol as both efficiency and enjoyment can carry the Shop + Savor premise into the identity.
demonstration: Two separated text blocks call the logo the root of the system and connect it to efficiency and enjoyment.
practical_value: Read the two statements before choosing which detail of the symbol to emphasize in an explanation.

content_islands.name: Two-part proposition
content_islands.spec: Stack the two dark green statements at the left on Cashew. Leave a gap after the first to distinguish the claim from its meaning.
